domain.description: The business's domain, as search_businesses or get_business gave it, like bikes.example.

message.description: What your person wants to ask, in their words.

subject.description: A few words the business sees first.

email.description: Your person's email address, which they agreed to give this business for its answer: one that receives mail, never a no-reply one or one at .invalid, .test or localhost.

name.description: Your person's name, as they gave it for the business to use: with a letter in it and no @, and never a placeholder (N/A, Test, {{name}}). A business's inbox refuses a request without it, or with one that is not a name.

contact.description: Who the request is from, as your person agreed to give it to this business: their name and their email address. Never a phone number.

consent.description: true only when your person agreed to give this business their name and email address for its answer. Without it nothing is sent.

language.description: The language your person wants the answer in, as a tag like en, pt or pt-BR.
